traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements for story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified: - Recommended and strict presets are exposed as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays via `configs.recommended` / `configs.strict` and are designed to be spread after a `plugins` registration object (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG). Integration tests using FlatESLint confirm they work alongside other configs, satisfying the Core Functionality, Quality Standards, and Integration criteria. - Rule schemas for configuration options are defined and validated (require-story-annotation, valid-story-reference, etc.), with tests confirming expected schema properties, rejection of unknown options, and clear error messages for invalid types (REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION, Error Handling criterion). - Customization of story paths and project boundaries is provided through valid-story-reference options (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) and thoroughly tested for both positive and negative cases (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS). - README and the ESLint v9 setup guide (in user-docs) together provide concrete examples, common configuration patterns, and troubleshooting guidance for flat-config setups across project types, fulfilling the User Experience and Documentation criteria. - All tests directly associated with this story (config presets, config validation, rule option schemas) are currently passing in the latest Jest run.
Given the unchanged story text and the passing, story-tagged tests that cover every listed requirement, this story is fully implemented and validated.
